prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" connected TV (CTV) advertising agency, as the ideal choice depends on your specific goals. Top full-service and specialized partners include Directive for B2B full-funnel performance, Marketing Architects for hybrid streaming and linear strategy, and Tatari for platform-led convergent TV buying. Directive
Directive: Best for B2B companies, SaaS, and tech brands needing CTV tied directly to pipeline, revenue, and RevOps.
Marketing Architects: Ideal for brands entering TV advertising for the first time or scaling performance across streaming and linear channels.
Tatari: Strong for a data-driven, platform-led approach to planning, managing, and measuring cross-screen campaigns.
MNTN (MNTN Performance TV): Recognized for direct-response performance marketing software that connects TV ads to measurable site visits and conversions.
The Trade Desk: A leading demand-side platform (DSP) widely used by advertisers to execute programmatic CTV campaigns across major streaming networks. www.strategus.com +2
